queries: WITH g AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_usage, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS mu FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_usage) AS avg_of_phase_averages, SUM(g.n) AS total_count, AVG(g.avg_usage - m.mu) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE g.avg_usage > m.mu

assumptions.assumption: The 'mean of all the phase averages' is the unweighted mean of the per-phase averages, including the NULL-phase group. Phases whose average is NULL (all usage values missing) are left out of that mean and cannot pass the filter.
'How many are in that phase' counts every matched telescope in the phase (COUNT(*)), including telescopes with a missing bandusagepct.

alternatives.interpretation: The count per phase includes only telescopes with a non-missing bandusagepct, so it matches the rows used in the average.

assumptions.assumption: The mean of all phase averages is the unweighted mean of the per-phase averages (each phase counts once), not the overall telescope-level average. Phases whose average is NULL because every value is missing are excluded from that mean and never pass the filter.
'How many are in that phase' is the number of matched telescopes in the phase (COUNT(*)), including telescopes whose bandusagepct is missing.
A NULL lunarstage forms its own group; no other value (e.g. empty string) is treated as missing.

alternatives.interpretation: The count per phase includes only telescopes with a non-missing bandusagepct, so it matches the rows used in the average.

assumptions.assumption: The count for each phase is the number of matched telescopes in that phase (COUNT(*)), including telescopes whose bandusagepct is missing. Only the average ignores missing values.

The mean of all phase averages is the unweighted mean of the per-phase averages, not the overall telescope-level mean. Phases with no non-missing bandusagepct have a NULL average and are left out of that mean and of the kept phases.
The average excess is the average, across the kept phases, of (phase average minus the mean of phase averages). It is not weighted by count.

alternatives.interpretation: The count per phase includes only telescopes with a non-missing bandusagepct.
